title: Russell Targ saw real miracles while working as a stage magician

tellings.quote: Russell Tar actually mentioned this too that like in his younger days he was a stage magician and would experience actual miracles

plain: A magician and video host named Chris Ramsay, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says a man named Russell Targ told of working as a stage magician in his younger days. According to Ramsay, Targ said that while doing magic tricks he would sometimes experience actual miracles. If true, it would mean real unexplained events can slip in among staged illusions.
